title: fev-bench: A Realistic Benchmark for Time Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2509.26468v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Benchmark quality is critical for meaningful evaluation and sustained progress in time series forecasting, particularly with the rise of pretrained models. Existing benchmarks often have limited domain coverage or overlook real-world settings such as tasks with covariates. Their aggregation procedures frequently lack statistical rigor, making it unclear whether observed performance differences reflect true improvements or random variation. Many benchmarks lack consistent evaluation infrastructure or are too rigid for integration into existing pipelines. To address these gaps, we propose fev-bench, a benchmark of 100 forecasting tasks across seven domains, including 46 with covariates. Supporting the benchmark, we introduce fev, a lightweight Python library for forecasting evaluation emphasizing reproducibility and integration with existing workflows. Using fev, fev-bench employs principled aggregation with bootstrapped confidence int

translated_title: fev-bench：一个贴近现实的时序预测基准
translated_abstract: 基准测试的质量对于时间序列预测领域的有效评估和持续进步至关重要，尤其是在预训练模型兴起的背景下。现有的基准测试往往领域覆盖范围有限，或忽视了带协变量任务等真实世界场景。它们的聚合程序常常缺乏统计严谨性，导致观测到的性能差异究竟反映的是真实提升还是随机波动变得难以判断。许多基准测试缺乏一致的评估基础设施，或者过于僵化而难以集成到现有工作流程中。为了弥补这些不足，我们提出了 fev-bench，这是一个涵盖七个领域共 100 个预测任务的基准，其中 46 个任务包含协变量。作为对该基准的支持，我们引入了 fev——一个轻量级的 Python 预测评估库，强调可复现性以及与现有工作流程的集成。借助 fev，fev-bench 采用基于自举（bootstrap）置信区间的严谨聚合方法……
tldr: 提出了 fev-bench——一个涵盖七个领域共 100 个任务（其中 46 个带协变量）的贴近现实的时间序列预测基准，并配套推出强调可复现性与易集成的轻量级 Python 评估库 fev，通过自举置信区间等统计严谨的聚合方式实现可靠模型评估。
en_tdlr: We propose fev-bench, a realistic time series forecasting benchmark of 100 tasks across seven domains (46 with covariates), together with fev, a lightweight Python evaluation library that enables statistically rigorous, reproducible model comparison via bootstrapped confidence intervals.
